scope.summary: Run the drape QA matrix per Section 13.27: all 8 archetypes x the starter garment set draped through the BkClothBridge hook (MT-592), gated on FIT and NO_INTERPENETRATION per cell with proxy freshness verified — the Cloth<->BodyKit contract proven across the full archetype space (REQ-023..025 at matrix scale).
acceptance_criteria: The matrix drapes every archetype x every starter garment via the MT-592 runner (grow-into-garment where no fit samples exist); each cell records the FIT metric and the interpenetration gate result.
Proxy freshness is asserted per cell: the collision proxy channel-state hash must match the archetype's current channel state before the drape counts (stale-proxy cells fail typed).
The ARCH-A x bra and ARCH-A x dress cells are named must-pass gates (the operator's canonical hard case from MT-593, now inside the matrix).
Obese archetypes (D/E) prove the belly/fat proxy lane; ARCH-F/H prove garments drape over genital geometry without tunneling.
Results persist machine-readable, keyed for staleness, and are consumable as a 13.27 validation stage.
scope.risk_if_missed: Garment support quietly holds only for average bodies; the extreme archetypes the product exists for fail at dress-up time, and the failure is found by the operator mid-production instead of by the matrix.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
